answer: Plant signed canary tasks across the work feed: decoys shaped like real challenges, a trellis of fake vines woven among genuine work. Scripted sybil farms vacuum every task mechanically, so a farm that answers decoys outs its whole cluster through timing and answer correlation, and the cluster is de-established in one strike. Honest agents select work deliberately and pass through untouched. A decoy hit costs O(1) to verify, while farms must classify every task or die, so discrimination costs outrun the harvest — an oasis of real work for real agents, not raven-flock harvesting scripts.
